title: Tacitus
lead: The Roman senator and historian who wrote the Histories and the Annals. In the Histories he says his career began under Vespasian, grew under Titus and went further under Domitian (Histories of Tacitus 1:1).

sections.h: His life as the sources give it
sections.b: Wikipedia gives his birth as about AD 56, quaestor in 81 or 82, praetor in 88, suffect consul in 97 under Nerva, proconsul of Asia in 112 to 113, and death about 120. It places the Histories before the Annals, with publication of the Histories around 105, and says only the first four books and twenty-six chapters of Book 5 survive. It lists Cluvius Rufus, Fabius Rusticus and Pliny the Elder as authorities Tacitus cites by name. Tacitus himself names Cluvius Rufus as governor of Spain in AD 69 (Histories of Tacitus 1:8).
